why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the DIN airdrop site Go to the DIN airdrop site , which the project homepage links as Claim Airdrop.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Press Connect Wallet on the airdrop site to link the wallet you want checked.
3 Step 3 : Check your eligibility The site checks whether the wallet is eligible to claim DIN. It gives no eligibility rules in advance, so the result on screen is the only answer.
4 Step 4 : Claim DIN if the wallet qualifies Follow the prompts on the airdrop site if it shows the wallet as eligible. The site gives no claim deadline.

5 Step 5 : Optionally open the staking page The staking page takes an amount of DIN and a lock period of 30D, 90D, 180D or 360D, and has a Claim Rewards tab. It is separate from the eligibility check.
